R190.note: Keyfunc type assertion plus WithValidMethods closes the alg-confusion path, but WithExpirationRequired (and pinning to RS256 alone, excluding RS384/RS512) rejects tokens the original accepted; stated, but a restriction beyond the finding.

R191.note: Shared self-seeded SecureRandom replaces the caller-seeded Random; dropping the seed parameter only removes a NumberFormatException failure path and is stated plainly.

R192.note: secure=true via the options array closes the finding, but samesite=Strict is a stated addition beyond the fix that withholds the auth cookie on cross-site top-level navigations (Lax would have been neutral).

R193.note: cmd.exe is removed, ping runs by absolute path with target as its own argv element, nslookup is replaced by net.LookupHost; the changed report format, 20s timeout, and leading-dash rejection are all stated and block no legitimate target.

R194.note: Tool name is mapped through an application-owned allowlist to an absolute path and target is placed after '--', which getopt-based ping honours; the ping-only map is consistent with the hardcoded '-c 4' and is stated.

R195.note: The allowlist regex is the only workable closure for a .bat sink and does close it, but it rejects report names containing '.' or other characters the original accepted (with a misleading 'required' error), and execFile with shell:true no longer quotes scriptPath, so an install path containing a space now breaks.

R196.note: Random name plus detected extension stored outside the static root and served by a validated route closes attacker control of name/extension; svg remains in ALLOWED and is served inline, but that is unchanged from the original and file-type does not sniff SVG.

R197.note: FromSqlInterpolated binds tenantId and the LIKE pattern as parameters with the query shape and return type unchanged; wildcard semantics of % in term are the same as before.

R198.note: Shared SecureRandom filling 16 bytes encoded base64url replaces Math.random; the token format change is stated and the value is still stored, compared, and set as a cookie identically.

R199.note: Forwarding to next(error) routes the failure to the existing generic 500 handler, which still logs the full error; 404 and success paths are untouched.

R200.note: supports() now opts in only for ApiKeyAuthenticationToken, matching the unconditional cast in authenticate(); nothing else changed.

R201.note: Passing requestedCapacity instead of MAX_PACKET_CAPACITY makes write_field's existing bounds check validate against the real allocation; writes that fit still succeed and oversize writes are still silently rejected.
